clue.text: Parapet built by fellow in transport business

clue.text: It's unusual, artist showing opulence, but not unknown

clue.text: Beating director finally in addition of soundtrack

clue.text: He recalls minister that's more acceptable, do we infer?

clue.text: The end of space exploration, in the main

explanation.definitionFit: Early crewed spacecraft finished their missions by landing in the ocean, the final stage of the voyage.

clue.text: You and I hang about at the same time

clue.text: Prepare for action: tidy up after game of rummy
